rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Define an admissible extremality notion stable under the reductions actually used. Prove a compactness, finite approximation, or minimal-counterexample statement before assuming existence of an optimizer.

deliverables.description: EXISTENCE_AND_LIMITS.md: proved existence/approximation and retained invariances

acceptance_criteria: Distinguish a maximum over a fixed finite dimension from a supremum over all dimensions; the latter need not be attained.
If using a minimal counterexample, state a fixed proposed constant and prove the relevant well-ordering/existence conclusion conditionally on a counterexample.
Show which tensor/balancing/activation operations preserve the chosen extremality property before using them in a structural argument.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A rigorous extremality framework supporting one nontrivial structural consequence, rather than an assumed optimizer.

assignments.target_statement: Seek a structural restriction forced by ratio extremality under every allowed physical descendant. Test the claim against known component-pruning failures and explain why criticality changes the argument.

deliverables.description: PRUNING_SCOPE.md: failed component rules and the new critical hypothesis

acceptance_criteria: Derive the structural restriction from the exact ratio or deficit comparison for every allowed physical descendant.
Replay the known component raw-entropy and maximum-component-ratio counterexamples; criticality must be used at a specified line.
Do not assume descendants inherit full criticality or that disconnected support permits lossless pruning without a separate proof.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new necessary structural lemma for a rigorously admitted critical class, or an embedding that invalidates it.

assignments.target_statement: Analyze point surgery on products and quantify entropy, influence, and mixed derivative curvature. Determine whether proposed primitivity or nonfactorization conditions really control hidden tensor structure.

deliverables.description: NEAR_TENSOR_PERTURBATIONS.tex: entropy, influence, and mixed-derivative expansions
HIDDEN_TENSOR_DIAGNOSTIC.md: which structural tests detect the seed factor

acceptance_criteria: Keep the signed Fourier perturbation terms and prove uniform remainder estimates in the tensor and defect parameters.
Quantify the proposed mixed-derivative or nonfactorization statistic, rather than inferring primitivity from visual circuit connectedness.
Show whether an arbitrarily hard tensor core still passes the proposed condition after tiny surgery, with all influence costs included.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A rigorous hidden-core admission result or a proved statistic that excludes the constructed near-tensor family.

assignments.target_statement: Replace false unrestricted component entropy or ratio inequalities by a controlled-excess theorem with an explicit interface term. Prove that the interface term can be paid in a stated critical class.

deliverables.description: COMPONENT_EXCESS.tex: corrected inequality and explicit interface term
CRITICAL_INTERFACE_PAYMENT.md: admitted class and full cost comparison

acceptance_criteria: Retain the existing counterexamples to raw component entropy subadditivity and maximum component ratio as mandatory controls.
Define the interface term independently of the desired conclusion; setting it equal to the unbounded unexplained entropy gap is not a payment.
Prove both the component comparison and an influence payment of the interface on the stated critical class; keep universal class admission separate.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete controlled-excess theorem with a useful paid interface or a parameterized counterexample to that interface.

assignments.target_statement: Try to realize arbitrary hard cores inside every proposed critical class. Preserve all extremality tests in the embedding or identify the exact failed condition.

deliverables.description: CRITICAL_CLASS_EMBEDDINGS.tex: seed construction and every admission test
EXTREMAL_SCOPE_VERDICTS.json: preserved, violated, or unresolved conditions

acceptance_criteria: Preserve all declared criticality tests in an arbitrary-hard-core embedding before concluding FEI-equivalence.
Distinguish mere connectedness/primitivity/all-block terminality from full ratio criticality; known failures of the former do not automatically refute the latter.
If an embedding fails, locate the exact inequality and prove the failure quantitatively instead of declaring the class genuinely easier.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A precise admission verdict for one live critical class, with the original seed and limiting ratio explicit.
